name: Hotel Sailer
beschreibung: Hotel Sailer is situated in Wenns within Tyrol's scenic Pitztal Valley. The traditionally operated hotel stands out for its alpine timber architecture and genuine family hospitality. The wellness area features an indoor swimming pool, a sauna, and a steam bath. Half-board includes a generous breakfast buffet and multi-course regional dinners. It serves as an ideal base for summer hiking and winter skiing across Hochzeiger, Rifflsee, and the Pitztal Glacier.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Sailer in Wenns in the Pitztal valley features alpine timber architecture, an indoor pool, a sauna and steam bath, and easy access to Pitztal ski resorts.
